verdict.rationale: Docs show server-side token generation for WebSDK, hosted/drop-in flows via WebSDK and permalinks, verification levels combining document and selfie/liveness checks, and webhooks to receive verification results — covering the full server-create → embed/redirect → read-result flow without building capture UI. Missing for 10: explicit end-to-end code sample for creating a session via REST API and reading the final decision via API (only webhook notification is shown), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the full flow.
